blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A Regional Trial Court (RTC) judge has acquitted the former spokesperson of the New People’s Army’s Melito Glor Command in Quezon Province of five counts of murder arising from a 2016 ambush. The acquittal came after the prosecution’s witnesses failed to identify him as one of the attackers. Judge Erwin Y. Dimayacyac of RTC Branch 42 in Pinamalayan town handed down the 8‑page ruling favoring Jaime Padilla, also known as Ka Diego, on November 11.
